Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a short historical comparison note for new board-operations reviewers explaining why Helio Start was excluded from the approved Q1 and Q2 2026 quarterly operating-evidence sections. For Q1, state what the evidence meant for Q2 forecast credit. For Q2, state what the day-7 result did and did not establish. Preserve the approved interpretation of the other three lanes in each package, and make the quarter-specific distinction clear rather than describing both exclusions as generic immaturity.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Historical comparison: why Helio Start was excluded from Q1 and Q2 2026 board evidence", "body": "Historical comparison for new board-operations reviewers

Helio Start was excluded from both approved quarterly operating-evidence sections, but for different quarter-specific reasons. The exclusions should not be summarized as generic immaturity.

Q1 2026 — evidence permitted proposal consideration, not forecast credit
Two consecutive mature organic cohorts satisfied the evidence condition for considering and preparing a capped Q2 paid-acquisition proposal. That was a gate for proposal preparation only. The exact cohort dates were still missing, and there was no approved budget, paid traffic, acquisition authorization, pipeline treatment, revenue claim, or forecast credit. Accordingly, Helio Start remained not board-ready and was excluded. The evidence could support preparation of a bounded proposal; it could not earn Q2 forecast credit.

The other three approved Q1 lanes retained their separate limits:
- Expansion Assist was descriptive operating evidence, not a causal result, because there was no randomized control; it carried no revenue, pipeline, or forecast treatment.
- Pricing-page path quality was post-rollout continuity evidence, not a second causal test.
- CS auto-nudge was evidence of system-control performance, not revenue or forecast evidence.

Q2 2026 — day-7 activation signal, not a mature outcome
The fixed 50-workspace paid cohort produced a 39-of-50 day-7 first-integration result. That result was an early activation/readiness signal only. It did not establish a mature Helio Start claim, complete day-90 paid-active status, refund-adjusted collected cash, account-level support effort, acquisition economics, revenue, pipeline, or forecast credit. The mature window remained incomplete, so Helio Start was excluded from the approved Q2 section pending complete day-90 outcomes. The day-7 result was retained as incomplete supporting evidence, not treated as a board-readiness or growth decision.

The other three approved Q2 lanes retained their separate limits:
- Expansion Assist remained descriptive, with no causal, revenue, pipeline, or forecast treatment.
- Pricing-page path quality remained post-rollout continuity evidence rather than a new causal result.
- CS auto-nudge evidence remained limited to system-control performance.

Bottom line: Q1 evidence crossed a proposal-preparation gate but not a commercial or forecast gate.
